description: worked-problems.md — convert the three full worked solutions (Parking Lot, Movie Booking/BookMyShow, Rate Limiter) from Python to COMPLETE, correct, simple-Java reference implementations, preserving the Step 1-6 structure, 'Key design trade-offs' subsections, the Rate Limiter algorithm table, and all talking points. Also fix the one list-rendering bug (~line 495 'Other decisions:'). Independent of the other features (distinct file). Longest code blocks — do carefully.
steps: Read LLD/worked-problems.md fully first. Update the intro note that currently says 'Python for the full code (runnable); ...' so it reads Java, and add a short note that these are reference implementations — correct and readable, NOT compiled/run by the workflow.

Problem 1 Parking Lot: convert to simple Java — enum VehicleSize; abstract Vehicle + Bike/Car/Truck; VehicleFactory; ParkingSpot; Level; SpotAllocationStrategy interface + FirstAvailableStrategy + BestFitStrategy; Ticket; ParkingLot. Keep a `public static void main` reproducing the Python demo (park a car at the best-fit medium spot, print 'parked at L0-2', then unpark and print fee 50.0) with a comment showing that expected output.

Problem 2 Movie Booking (BookMyShow): convert to simple Java — enum SeatStatus{FREE,HELD,BOOKED}; Seat; PaymentGateway interface + UpiGateway; Show with a per-seat ReentrantLock (hold/confirm/_release_if_held) and a ScheduledExecutorService (or java.util.Timer) for the 5-min auto-release; Booking.checkout that holds all seats with rollback, pays, then confirms. Keep a `public static void main` reproducing the demo: b1 books A1,A2 -> true; b2 books A2 -> false; A2 status BOOKED — with a comment showing that expected output. Preserve the per-seat-lock talking points and the 'If pushed on scale' note.

Problem 3 Rate Limiter: convert to simple Java — RateLimitStrategy interface; FixedWindowLimiter, TokenBucketLimiter, SlidingWindowLogLimiter, each with a per-key ReentrantLock (use a Map<String,ReentrantLock>, or ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent); RateLimiter delegating to the strategy. Keep a `public static void main`: FixedWindow limit=3/1s -> [true,true,true,false,false]; then a 20-thread burst on TokenBucket capacity=5 prints '~5, never more' — with a comment showing expected output. PRESERVE the algorithm comparison table and the 'Other decisions' list.

Fix the list bug at ~line 495: 'Other decisions:' is immediately followed by '- ' bullets with no blank line (renders as one run-on

). Insert a blank line after the lead-in; keep each bullet's wrapped continuation lines indented. Preserve the 3 bullets (per-key vs global lock, in-memory vs distributed, eviction).

Run the strict build and confirm the worked-problems HTML renders 'Other decisions' as a <ul>. Commit locally on branch lld-java (e.g. `refactor(LLD): worked-problems Java reference solutions + list fix`). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 3 problems has a ```java block containing `public static void main` with a comment showing the same expected output the Python demo printed.
The BookMyShow solution uses per-seat locking and the Rate Limiter uses per-key locking (correct concurrency); the Rate Limiter algorithm comparison table is preserved.
Step 1-6 structure, 'Key design trade-offs' subsections, and talking points are preserved; a note says the solutions are reference implementations (not compiled/run).
In site/LLD/worked-problems/index.html the 'Other decisions' block renders as a <ul>; `cd <worktree> && DISABLE_MKDOCS_2_WARNING=true python -m mkdocs build --strict` exits 0 with no NEW WARNING.

python -c "h=open('site/LLD/worked-problems/index.html',encoding='utf-8').read(); i=h.find('Other decisions'); seg=h[i:i+500]; print('OK' if '<li>' in seg and '<ul>' in seg else 'RUNON')"
findings: Converted all 3 worked solutions in LLD/worked-problems.md from Python to simple, interview-minimal Java. Parking Lot: enum VehicleSize (ordinal ordering), abstract Vehicle + Bike/Car/Truck, VehicleFactory (switch), ParkingSpot/Level, SpotAllocationStrategy interface + FirstAvailable/BestFit, Ticket, ParkingLot (HashMap plate->ticket); main prints 'parked at L0-2' then 'fee: 50.0'. BookMyShow: enum SeatStatus{FREE,HELD,BOOKED}, PaymentGateway interface + UpiGateway, Show with one ReentrantLock per seat (hold/confirm/releaseIfHeld) and a shared ScheduledExecutorService for the 5-min auto-release, Booking.checkout holds all seats with rollback then pays then confirms; main prints b1:true, b2:false, A2 status: BOOKED (scheduler.shutdown so JVM exits). Rate Limiter: RateLimitStrategy interface, PerKeyLimiter base using ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent for one ReentrantLock per key, FixedWindow/TokenBucket/SlidingWindowLog strategies, RateLimiter delegator; main prints [true,true,true,false,false] then 'allowed under burst: 5' via 20 threads + AtomicInteger. Each block ends with an 'Expected output:' comment. Updated intro note to say Java and added an admonition that these are reference implementations (not compiled/run). Preserved Step 1-6 structure, all 'Key design trade-offs' subsections, the Rate Limiter algorithm comparison table, and all talking points. Fixed the 'Other decisions:' list-rendering bug by inserting a blank line after the lead-in (3 bullets preserved). Verification: grep python fences = 0; grep 'public static void main' = 3; strict mkdocs build exits 0 with only pre-existing INFO (no new LLD WARNING, no Aborted); 'Other decisions' HTML check returns OK (<ul>/<li>). Java is not compiled in this repo; correctness verified by careful review.
